'''Kireyin''' is an officer in the [[Ghealdan]] army. He is nobly born. 

== Appearance ==
He is lean with a haughty gaze.

== Activities ==
[[Gerard Arganda]] assigns him to lead the Ghealdan troops to [[So Habor]]. While there he sees a ghost. He is left in charge of over seeing the winnowing process of the grain when [[Perrin Aybara]] [[Travel]]s back to camp.
